keyUpMap.label: Key Up Map
keyUpMap.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event, e.g. `{ ArrowLeft: 'STOP' }`.

platforms.label: Platforms
platforms.description: Side-view level geometry (pixel AABBs, same contract as Canvas2D).

playerSprite.label: Player Sprite
playerSprite.description: Player model — named for 2D parity; in 3D the Asset's url is a GLB.

tileSprites.label: Tile Sprites
tileSprites.description: Platform-type → model map — named for 2D parity; values are GLB Assets.

assetManifest.label: Asset Manifest
assetManifest.description: Per-role model manifest; resolves tiles/units/features without explicit modelUrl/assetUrl.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Board zoom/group scale. Applied to the scene group. Default 0.45.

unitScale.label: Unit Scale
unitScale.description: Unit draw-size multiplier. 1 = default tile-proportional size.

useInstancing.label: Use Instancing
useInstancing.description: Whether to use instancing for tiles

player.label: Player
player.description: Side-view player (pixel coords, LOLO-owned physics) — presence switches to side-scroller rendering.

interpolateUnits.label: Interpolate Units
interpolateUnits.description: Opt-in: smooth-lerp unit positions between LOLO tick snapshots. DEFAULT OFF.

keyMap.label: Key Map
keyMap.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event, e.g. `{ ArrowLeft: 'LEFT', Space: 'JUMP' }`. The input layer emits `UI:<event>` so the FSM stays device-agnostic — keyboard and d-pad converge.

pixelsPerUnit.label: Pixels Per Unit
pixelsPerUnit.description: Pixel→world-unit divisor for side view (default 32 = one 2D tile per 3D cell).
